instructions: This file is one part of the interface of Forge Studio, an AI image and video app (Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge).
Translate every value in "texts" (and in "blocks", when there is one) into the language you were asked for. Never change a key: the program finds each text by its English key.
Fill in "language" with the language's own name (for example "Español"), "code" with its short code (for example "es" or "pt-br"), and set "direction" to "rtl" for a language written right to left.

Keep exactly as they are: {0}, {name} and other words in curly braces, %s, ${...}, HTML tags and their attributes, emoji, \n line breaks, numbers and units, keyboard keys, file names and paths, and code.

Keep the names of models, samplers, programs and formats in English (FLUX, SDXL, SD 1.5, LoRA, ControlNet, AnimateDiff, Deforum, Wan, VAE, CFG, Euler a, LCM, Hires. fix, PNG, MP4...). For a technical term the user will meet in English tutorials, add the English in brackets once, for example "Escala CFG (CFG Scale)".
Short labels stay short: they are buttons, tabs and field names. Use the plain, friendly words a video editor or a photo app uses in that language.
A value that should stay in English may stay unchanged.
Return the complete file as valid JSON with the same structure and nothing before or after it.

texts.Every world is a 360 panorama: generate: Every world is a 360 panorama: generate it from a prompt (with the 360 LoRA and Tile X, so it has no seam), or upload a picture or a video.
texts.Move inside the world with the mouse, th: Move inside the world with the mouse, the keyboard or a gamepad. Every world has a depth map, so near things pass far things when you move.
texts.Mark a place (a door, a gate, a window): Mark a place (a door, a gate, a window) with the marking tools or the automatic selection, and make it a portal into another world. The next world is seen through it in its own depth, and you walk into it with no jump. A portal can also be the way on (the far part of a street): then the two worlds are one place.
texts.Add characters and objects: place an Ope: Add characters and objects: place an OpenPose figure or mark an area, write a prompt, and the drawing becomes part of the world. An object can become a real 3D model (Hunyuan3D-2) that stands in the world, walks and is seen from every side; such a model can also be made out of words, or uploaded as a .glb file. In the Dialogue tab give a character a line and a voice, and it talks.
texts.Draw a camera route or record your own f: Draw a camera route or record your own flight, then render a video at the resolution, frame rate and format you choose.
